learning_outcomes.text: Understand the different types of steels, characteristics, and technical bases of steel treatments, and the latest trends in the sector.
Understand the influence of mechanical and thermal properties of ceramic materials on their applications and processing.
Learn the characteristics, applications, and processing methods of polymeric materials.
Understand the mechanisms of elastic and plastic deformation of polymers.
Understand the dependence of composite material behavior on the characteristics, relative quantities, geometry, distribution, and properties of their constituent phases.
Understand the types of corrosion and degradation, as well as their causes and mechanisms, to take measures and prevent them from occurring.
Solve simple practical cases of material selection.

syllabus_topics: Ceramic Materials and Glasses. Applications and shaping.
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of a written exam (70%), laboratory practices (20%), and continuous assessment tasks (10%). The written exam is recoverable in the extraordinary sitting. A partial exam can eliminate part of the final exam if passed with a minimum grade of 5, contributing 50% to the written exam score. Laboratory practices and continuous assessment tasks are non-recoverable, but their scores from the ordinary sitting are carried over to the extraordinary sitting. For the global evaluation, a written test accounts for 80% and a laboratory practical for 20%.
